status: R9/R10 identities and values source/photo-closed; R15 lower→D3.5 and R16 right→D3.3 photo-closed; opposite returns continuity-held

factory_assembly.reading: Beside D3, two upright bodies to the left are R10 (outer/left) and R9 (inner/right). R15 is the separate upright body to the right of D3. R16 is the horizontal body below D3.

exact_electrical.reading: R9 and R10 are 2 kΩ pull-ups to rail A/+5 V for INT7_RAW and INT6_RAW respectively.
exact_electrical.r15_r16_reading: R15 and R16 are separately drawn 12 kΩ branches from D3.5/D26.14 and D3.3/D26.15 to ground return bars.

owner_component.left_pair_observation: Two upright resistor bodies immediately left of the bottom-notched D3 package each show mirrored red-black-red/gold 2 kΩ bands; they correspond positionally to factory R10 (outer left) and R9 (inner right). Their upper leads appear joined, consistent with the source common +5 V rail but requiring continuity.
owner_component.r15_observation: A separate upright red body immediately right of D3 occupies the factory R15 position; its dark inscription is compatible with 12K but not a conclusive isolated resistance measurement.
owner_component.r16_observation: A separate horizontal red body immediately below D3 occupies the factory R16 position; its inscription appears compatible with 12K but remains to be measured.

d3_local_registration.basis: ref/photos/juku-pcb-2/local-package-registration.json D3 component fit; current source PCB D3 pad coordinates
d3_local_registration.interpretation: D3-local fit supports separate R10-left/R9-right placements with approximately 10.16 mm vertical lead spans. Physical conductor identity still needs continuity.

retraction: The prior r15-r16-two-face-review.json assigned the left pair to R15/R16 by proximity. Original-resolution factory labels disprove that identity. Its four-joint solder geometry remains useful for R9/R10 only; it cannot establish R15/R16 value or rail.

R15 upper lead against +5 V/GND and isolated R15 value; optionally corroborate the photo-closed lower→D3.5 path
